altitude-acclimatization.name: Altitude Acclimatization Schedule
altitude-acclimatization.intro: Enter your start and target altitude to generate a day-by-day ascent plan, assess altitude-sickness risk and get a recommended ascent rate for safe mountaineering and high-plateau travel.

analysis-19.name: Tactical Attack/Defense Video Analysis
analysis-19.intro: Structurally tag attack and defense clips from match video, tally attack-defense transitions and key rounds, and support coaching tactical review with clean statistics.

analysis-20.name: Shooting Score & Stability Analysis
analysis-20.intro: Enter each shot’s ring score to compute the mean, within-group spread and stability metrics, then generate a score trend for shooting-training review.

analysis-spacing.name: Climbing Bolt Spacing & Force Analysis
analysis-spacing.intro: Bolt spacing, fall factor and force analysis for climbing protection.

assessor-csat.name: Satisfaction & Effectiveness Assessment
assessor-csat.intro: Customer satisfaction, training effectiveness and reporting methodology.

assessor-hardness.name: Impact Hardness Finger Test
assessor-hardness.intro: Finger-test protocol for assessing impact area hardness in martial arts training.

assessor-risk-2.name: Sports Injury Risk Assessment (Questionnaire)
assessor-risk-2.intro: A sports-injury risk questionnaire based on Functional Movement Screen (FMS) and injury-risk factors, scoring risk across exercise habits, injury history, flexibility, core strength and recovery management.

baofali-zongtiao-lidingtiaoyuan.name: Explosive Power Calculator (Vertical Jump / Long Jump)
baofali-zongtiao-lidingtiaoyuan.intro: Enter jump height or distance and body weight to estimate power output and an explosive-power index for athlete physical assessment.

calc-61.name: Activity Calorie Expenditure Calculator (MET)
calc-61.intro: Based on a MET (metabolic equivalent) activity database, pick an activity and enter body weight and duration to compute calories burned for fitness tracking, fat-loss planning and energy-balance checks.

calc-62.name: Baseball Batting & Pitching Statistics
calc-62.intro: Compute baseball batting average (AVG), on-base percentage (OBP), slugging (SLG) and OPS, plus pitching ERA and WHIP from game stats.

calc-angle-slope.name: Ski Slope Angle & Grade Calculator
calc-angle-slope.intro: Enter vertical drop and horizontal distance to convert a slope percentage into the slope angle, for ski-run difficulty grading and safety notes.

calc-heart-rate-1.name: Heart Rate Reserve (Karvonen) Calculator
calc-heart-rate-1.intro: Using the Karvonen formula with age and resting heart rate, compute target training heart-rate zones (heart-rate-reserve method) for scientific aerobic-intensity control.

calc-length-cutting.name: Kinesiology Tape Cutting Length Calculator
calc-length-cutting.intro: Pick a taping site and enter the measured length to compute the kinesiology-tape length, anchor positions and cutting shape for personalized sports-taping prep.

calc-time.name: Dive No-Decompression Limit (NDL) Calculator
calc-time.intro: Based on the PADI metric no-decompression table, compute the no-decompression limit, maximum operating depth and pressure group for a given depth.

calculator-calc-9.name: Cycling Gear Ratio Calculator
calculator-calc-9.intro: Enter chainring, cog and wheel diameter to compute gear ratio, distance per crank revolution, gear inches and speed at different cadences for road and mountain bike setup.

calculator-calc-time.name: Marathon Pace Calculator
calculator-calc-time.intro: Enter a target finish time or target pace to compute marathon pace, average speed and per-kilometre splits for training plans and race pacing strategy.

climbing-grade-converter.name: Climbing Grade Converter (V / YDS / French / UK)
climbing-grade-converter.intro: Convert climbing grades across major systems — V-scale bouldering, YDS, French and British — from V0 entry to V16 top, for cross-system training and route choice.

convert-13.name: Climbing Grade Converter (V ↔ YDS)
convert-13.intro: A climbing-grade converter between the V scale and YDS: enter either grade for a two-way mapping of the two climbing-difficulty systems.

convert-29.name: Kick Height & Flexibility Relationship
convert-29.intro: Convert kick height (distance from ground) to flexibility indicators and vice versa.

convert-47.name: One-Rep Max (1RM) Estimator
convert-47.intro: A one-rep-max (1RM) estimator: enter a weight lifted for a given number of repetitions and estimate the single maximal repetition from estimation formulas for strength-load setting.

convert-time.name: Triathlon Transition Time Calculator
convert-time.intro: A triathlon transition-time calculator: sum swim, bike and run segment times with transition times to get total time and each segment’s share for race-pace analysis.

detector-14.name: Anaerobic Threshold (AT) Detector
detector-14.intro: Detect the anaerobic threshold (AT) breakpoint from heart-rate data at increasing exercise intensities: enter heart rates at different intensities to auto-identify the HR breakpoint and AT intensity.

dianjiezhi-diushi-buchong.name: Electrolyte Loss & Replacement Calculator
dianjiezhi-diushi-buchong.intro: Estimate sodium, potassium and other electrolyte losses from sweat volume and exercise duration, and give fluid and replenishment advice for endurance-sport protection.

estimate-22.name: Hydration Strategy Estimator
estimate-22.intro: From body weight, exercise duration, ambient temperature and intensity, predict sweat loss and dehydration level and suggest a scientific hydration rhythm.

estimate-35.name: Sweat Rate Estimator
estimate-35.intro: Enter pre- and post-exercise body weight and duration to estimate sweat rate and dehydration percentage by the weighing method, with recommended fluid replacement for endurance training and racing.

estimate-tester.name: VO2max Estimator (Running Test)
estimate-tester.intro: Estimate VO2max from a Cooper 12-minute run test using VO2max = (distance − 504.9) / 44.73, with several running-test methods supported.

generator-random-3.name: Yoga Pose Sequence Generator
generator-random-3.intro: Generate a yoga sequence from a built-in pose library with tips, adjustable duration and intensity, for home practice planning — generated locally.

heart-rate-1.name: Maximum Heart Rate Calculator
heart-rate-1.intro: Compare several maximum-heart-rate formulas (such as 220 − age) to individualize HRmax and partition warm-up, fat-burn, aerobic and anaerobic training zones for scientific training.

heart-rate-2.name: Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Analyzer
heart-rate-2.intro: Enter an R-R interval series (milliseconds, space/comma/newline separated) to compute time-domain HRV metrics SDNN, RMSSD and pNN50 for autonomic-nervous-system assessment.

heart-rate-3.name: Heart Rate Recovery (HRR) Index
heart-rate-3.intro: Enter heart rate at exercise stop and after 1/2/3 minutes of recovery to compute the heart-rate recovery (HRR) value for cardiovascular-function and recovery assessment.

hongxibao-xieyang-shiyingxing.name: Red Blood Cell Oxygen-Carrying Adaptation Calculator
hongxibao-xieyang-shiyingxing.intro: Estimate red-cell augmentation and VO2max adaptation from altitude and training factors for evaluating high-altitude training effects.

jianzhong-tuoshui-buye-kongzhi.name: Weight-Cut (Dehydration / Rehydration) Control Calculator
jianzhong-tuoshui-buye-kongzhi.intro: A weight-cut (dehydration/rehydration) control calculator: estimate required dehydration/rehydration from target weight and weight-class, and flag a safe weight-loss range for weigh-in sports.

jixianwei-kuai-man-leixingtuice.name: Muscle Fiber Type (Fast/Slow) Estimator
jixianwei-kuai-man-leixingtuice.intro: A muscle-fiber fast/slow type estimator: combine sport characteristics and test data to infer fast- or slow-twitch dominance and guide training direction.

juzhongzongchengji-sinclair-xishu.name: Weightlifting Total & Sinclair Coefficient Calculator
juzhongzongchengji-sinclair-xishu.intro: Enter snatch and clean-and-jerk results and body weight to compute total, the Sinclair body-weight coefficient and a cross-weight predicted total for weightlifting scoring and comparison.

lanqiumingzhonglv-lanbanxiaolv.name: Basketball Shooting & Rebound Efficiency
lanqiumingzhonglv-lanbanxiaolv.intro: Compute field-goal percentage, true shooting percentage (TS%), rebound rate and a Hollinger game score from basketball box-score inputs.

lingmin-zhefanpao-chengji.name: Agility (Shuttle Run) Score Calculator
lingmin-zhefanpao-chengji.intro: A shuttle-run agility score calculator: convert shuttle-run time into an agility rating and improvement margin for athlete agility testing.

pilaohuifuqushi.name: Fatigue Recovery Trend Calculator (CK / BUN)
pilaohuifuqushi.intro: Enter creatine kinase (CK) and blood urea nitrogen (BUN) with sex to assess muscle damage and metabolic fatigue, compute a composite fatigue index and suggest recovery time.

pingheng-biyandanjiao-shichang.name: Balance (Eyes-Closed Single-Leg Stand) Timer
pingheng-biyandanjiao-shichang.intro: A balance (eyes-closed single-leg stand) duration recorder: log stand time and compare against norms to assess balance ability for rehab and fitness testing.

pingpangqiu-xiangchi-faqiu-defen.name: Table Tennis Rally / Serve Scoring Analysis
pingpangqiu-xiangchi-faqiu-defen.intro: A table-tennis rally/serve scoring tool: log rally and serve-round points to compute scoring rate and key-point performance for technique-tactics analysis.

rater-34.name: Volleyball Skill Rating (Pass / Spike)
rater-34.intro: A volleyball skill rater scoring technique from two core dimensions — pass accuracy and spike success — combined with serve and block for a composite rating.

rater-35.name: Judo Technique Rating (Tachi-waza / Ne-waza)
rater-35.intro: A judo technique rater scoring from two dimensions — standing throws (Tachi-waza) and ground techniques (Ne-waza) — combined with ippon, waza-ari and yuko scoring.

rater-36.name: Equestrian Performance Rating (Gait / Jumping)
rater-36.intro: An equestrian performance rater scoring from four dimensions — gait quality, jumping technique, rider posture and course accuracy — for dressage and show jumping.

rater-motion.name: Movement Stability Rating (Standard Deviation)
rater-motion.intro: A movement-stability rater: analyze the deviation of repeated lifts/throws to quantify technique stability; smaller standard deviation means higher stability.

ratio-18.name: Fat Oxidation Energy Ratio Calculator
ratio-18.intro: From exercise intensity (%VO2max) estimate the fat vs carbohydrate energy ratio and predict fat burned during exercise, for fat-loss and endurance training.

rehab-motion.name: Injury Prevention & Rehab Exercise Library
rehab-motion.intro: An injury-prevention and rehab exercise library: recommend preventive or rehabilitative movements by injury site and rehab phase and track completion for injury management.

rouren-qianqu-cequ-jinbu.name: Flexibility (Forward / Side Bend) Progress Tracker
rouren-qianqu-cequ-jinbu.intro: A flexibility (forward/side bend) progress tracker: log sit-and-reach and similar tests, convert to improvement margin and rating for flexibility training tracking.

shejiansanbubanjing.name: Archery Group Radius (CEP) Calculator
shejiansanbubanjing.intro: Enter the landing coordinates of several arrows relative to the target center (cm) to compute the mean point of impact, group radius (CEP), extreme spread and radial standard deviation for shooting precision.

sheyangdonglixuebanshi.name: Oxygen Uptake Kinetics Half-Time Calculator
sheyangdonglixuebanshi.intro: Enter resting VO2, target (steady-state) VO2 and the time to 50% change to compute the oxygen-uptake kinetics time constant τ, half-time and time to reach each percentage of steady state.

shuimianhuifuzhiliang.name: Sleep Recovery Quality Index
shuimianhuifuzhiliang.intro: Enter sleep duration, deep-sleep ratio and sleep-onset latency to compute a sleep-recovery index, assess recovery state and suggest the day’s training intensity.

simulator-18.name: High-Altitude Hypoxia Adaptation Simulator
simulator-18.intro: A high-altitude hypoxia adaptation simulator: model blood-oxygen and ventilation changes at different altitudes to understand altitude-adaptation physiology for training education.

sleeping-bag-rating.name: Sleeping Bag Temperature Rating Lookup (EN13537)
sleeping-bag-rating.intro: An EN13537 sleeping-bag temperature-rating lookup: enter expected ambient temperature to recommend a suitable comfort/limit temperature bag for outdoor camping gear choice.

speed-5.name: Speed / Acceleration Decomposition Calculator
speed-5.intro: Enter initial velocity, final velocity, time and mass to compute acceleration, resultant force, displacement, kinetic-energy change and power output for sprint, cycling and throwing mechanics.

speed-6.name: Fencing Lunge Speed Analysis
speed-6.intro: Enter lunge distance, front-foot displacement and completion time to compute average lunge speed, peak speed, acceleration and attack effect for fencing technique assessment.

sports-calculator.name: Sports & Outdoor Calculator Hub
sports-calculator.intro: A one-stop sports and outdoor calculator hub: running pace, heart-rate zones, cycling gear ratio, strength training, ski slope and pace-speed conversion.

sports-reference.name: Sports & Outdoor Reference Hub
sports-reference.intro: A one-stop sports and outdoor reference hub: climbing grades, sleeping-bag ratings, tent wind resistance, yoga poses, dive safety and fitness assessment.

sports-schedule.name: Weekly Workout Schedule Generator
sports-schedule.intro: A weekly workout-schedule generator: auto-build a week of training from goal (fat loss / muscle gain / endurance) and level, balancing intensity and recovery.

sports-stats.name: Workout Data Statistics Tracker
sports-stats.intro: A workout data statistics tool: log distance, pace and heart rate from running, cycling and other activities and generate trend charts for training management.

stats-11.name: Athletics Performance Records System
stats-11.intro: Statistical system for competition results, certificates and records.

stats-8.name: Soccer Match Statistics (Possession / Pass)
stats-8.intro: A soccer match statistics tool: enter possession, pass-success rate and shots to summarize team technique-tactics metrics for post-match analysis.

strength-5.name: 80/20 Polarized Training Week Planner
strength-5.intro: A weekly training-intensity distributor following the 80/20 polarized-training principle: allocate weekly training volume into low- and high-intensity and generate a daily plan.

swimming-stroke-efficiency.name: Swimming Stroke Efficiency Calculator (DPS / SR / SWOLF)
swimming-stroke-efficiency.intro: Compute distance per stroke (DPS), stroke rate (SR) and the SWOLF efficiency index to assess swimming technique and economy.

taiquandao-hengti-xiapi-defen.name: Taekwondo Kick Scoring Analysis
taiquandao-hengti-xiapi-defen.intro: A taekwondo kick (roundhouse/axe) scoring tool: log effective strikes and scoring moves to compute scoring rate and technique-application distribution for targeted training.

tent-wind-rating.name: Tent Wind Resistance Rating Lookup
tent-wind-rating.intro: Cross-reference the Beaufort wind scale with tent wind-resistance grades and give a suitable tent type and wind-safety advice by wind speed for camping tent choice and weather-risk assessment.

tester-1.name: Bodyweight Max-Rep 1RM Estimator (Push-up / Pull-up)
tester-1.intro: Enter body weight, movement type and reps-to-failure and combine bodyweight load ratios with the Epley and Brzycki formulas to estimate the movement 1RM and relative strength.

tester-7.name: Endurance Test Evaluator (AT / VO2max)
tester-7.intro: An endurance-test evaluator combining anaerobic threshold (AT) and VO2max to assess aerobic-endurance level, with training-zone advice and an endurance grade.

tester-8.name: Maximal Accumulated Oxygen Deficit (MAOD) Test
tester-8.intro: A maximal accumulated oxygen deficit (MAOD) test tool: estimate anaerobic capacity from an incremental-load test by computing accumulated oxygen deficit for anaerobic ability and lactate tolerance.

time-31.name: Wrestling Match Time Allocation
time-31.intro: Enter total match time and number of rounds to compute each round duration, rest time and per-round pacing strategy for wrestling rhythm and energy allocation.

tongqibizhifenxi.name: Ventilatory Equivalents & Threshold (VE/VO2) Analysis
tongqibizhifenxi.intro: Enter ventilation (VE) and oxygen uptake (VO2) at graded incremental loads to compute the VE/VO2 ventilatory equivalent, auto-detect the ventilatory threshold (VT) and assess the aerobic-anaerobic transition.

training-load.name: Supercompensation Training Load Scheduler
training-load.intro: Enter training load (rTSS), planned recovery time and personal adaptation coefficient to compute peak timing, current recovery phase and optimal next-session timing from a supercompensation model.

training-planner.name: Personalized Training Plan Generator
training-planner.intro: A personalized training-plan generator: build a tailored plan from goal, level and available time, with exercises, sets/reps and progressive loading.

triathlon-transition.name: Triathlon Transition Time Calculator
triathlon-transition.intro: Enter swim, bike and run segment results and transition-zone times to compute total time and visualize each segment’s share for triathlon post-race review and weakness analysis.

wangqiudefenlvfenxi.name: Tennis Serve Statistics Analysis
wangqiudefenlvfenxi.intro: Enter serve-related data to compute ace rate, double-fault rate, first-serve in-rate, break-point save rate and a composite serve-efficiency index for serve performance and key-point ability.

xuerusuanyuzhiceding.name: Blood Lactate Threshold Tester
xuerusuanyuzhiceding.intro: Fit a curve from heart-rate and blood-lactate data at graded-load testing to estimate lactate-threshold heart rate for endurance training-intensity zoning.

yangmaiboxiaolv.name: Oxygen Pulse Efficiency Calculator
yangmaiboxiaolv.intro: Enter oxygen uptake (VO2) and heart rate (HR) to compute oxygen pulse (O2 pulse = VO2 ÷ HR), estimate stroke volume (SV) and assess cardiopulmonary and heart-pump efficiency.

yoga-pose-generator.name: Yoga Pose Random Generator
yoga-pose-generator.intro: Choose difficulty and practice duration to randomly generate a yoga sequence with 30+ common poses and an order suggestion for home practice and class planning.

youyonghuashuixiaolv-swolf.name: Swimming Stroke Efficiency (SWOLF) Calculator
youyonghuashuixiaolv-swolf.intro: Enter stroke, pool length, single-length time and stroke count to compute SWOLF, distance per stroke, stroke rate and an efficiency grade for swimming economy and technique.

yumaoqiushaqiuxiaolv.name: Badminton Smash Efficiency Calculator
yumaoqiushaqiuxiaolv.intro: Enter smash average speed, count, direct points and errors to compute smash scoring rate, error rate, efficiency and an attack-efficiency composite for offensive quality.

zhangpengfangfengxishu.name: Tent Wind-Resistance Coefficient Calculator
zhangpengfangfengxishu.intro: Choose tent type, pole material and pole count to estimate maximum wind speed resistance, Beaufort grade and safe-camping advice as a wind-environment safety reference.
